proposal.name: Keep the watcher's paths out of build records

plan.name: Keep the watcher's paths out of build records
plan.summary: A build's result.json, committed under refs/invariant/runs/ where anyone can fetch it, records synth.Result.Dir as an absolute path on the watcher's machine, which names its user. Before runBuild in internal/factory/factory.go saves the result, it records a copy whose Dir is relative to the factory's work directory, in slash form (such as issue-1/build-20260928-120000/result), or empty when the directory isn't under it; the live result the run uses is unchanged, and nothing reads Dir back from a saved record. The other records were checked: a draft's proposal holds only repository-relative project directories, and a plan build's record holds no paths. What's left for a follow-up is free-form error text, such as a run's saved Error, a draft's Problem and failure comments, which can quote a path under the work directory when an agent run fails.

tests.name: TestSavedBuildResultHoldsNoLocalPath
tests.says: A build's result saved under refs/invariant/runs/ for a run under a temporary work directory holds no absolute path and no part of the work directory's own path.

usage.summary:
The plan and acceptance test are written, but I couldn't confirm them: all three `check` runs timed out after 900 seconds without a result. I'm stopping with one check left, because I can't run tests myself to find out whether my test hangs or the checker is stuck.

**The plan (`plan.json`):** a build's `result.json` is committed under `refs/invariant/runs/`, and its `dir` field records where the finished project was on the watcher's machine. Before `runBuild` in `internal/factory/factory.go:1162` saves it, it will record `dir` relative to the factory's work directory (for example `issue-1/build-…/result`). If the directory isn't under the work directory, it records nothing. That's the only file the build may change. Nothing reads `dir` back from a saved record, and the run itself still uses the full path.

**The acceptance test (`tests/internal/factory/runpaths_accept_test.go`):** it runs an issue through a build using the existing test setup, with the builder reporting its folder the way the real one does. It then reads the saved `result.json` from the runs ref and fails if any value is an absolute path or contains the work directory's path. It should fail on the current code, but no check has shown that.

**What else I checked, as the issue asks:** a draft's record holds only project folder paths inside the repository, and a plumbing build's record holds no paths. One leak is left for a follow-up: error text can quote a local path when an agent run fails. That covers a build's saved `error` field, a draft's `problem` text, and the failure comments the factory posts. The plan's summary says this.

**Possible causes of the timeouts:**
- The test hangs. Nothing in it looks like it could: wrapping the builder works the same way `crash_test.go` does it.
- The checker's own setup is stuck. The pattern fits this, since it timed out three times at exactly the limit, but I can't confirm it.

Running `go test -run TestSavedBuildResultHoldsNoLocalPath ./internal/factory/` in a copy of `repo/` with the test file added would show which one it is. After that, the last check can confirm the plan.
